[[Sharur]] is a [[Legendary weapon|legendary]] hammer crafted in the [[Mystic Forge]]. 

== Lore ==
{{Legendary unlock text|Sharur was retrieved from among the spectral weapons guarding the Source of Orr. Though its lingering corruption is aimless and benign, not even the [[Artesian Waters]] could fully cleanse it.}}

== Graphics ==
'''Sharur''' is an [[Ruins of Orr|Orrian]]-themed hammer with a pure appearance at [[Day and night|day]] and a corrupted one at night. 

;Aura
* At day, both arms of the wielder are encased by a teal mist.
* At night, the mist is replaced by coral.

;Draw/Stow effects
* Upon drawing the weapon at day, accompanied by a distinct sound, the wielder is engulfed in a flare of pure blue-green light that is absorbed into the body of the character. The plates around the orbs shift while in combat stance. Further, the orbs at the top of the weapon glow intensely. At night, the light explosion is replaced by an unholy-sounding wail. In addition, coral and tendrils sprout out of its bottom and a decorator crab adorns its top. The blue of the orbs also changes to red.

;Footfalls
* For a few seconds, coral, accompanied by the splashing of water, grow out of bright teal pools of light. Occasionally, tiny corrupted limbs will flail out of a puddle instead. 

;Skill effects
* Ranged skills will throw Sharur instead of the default projectile. This effect changes the following skills:
** {{g}} [[Guardian]]: {{skill icon|Zealot's Embrace}}.
*** {{dragonhunter}} [[Dragonhunter]]: {{skill icon|Spear of Justice}}.
** {{re}} [[Revenant]]: {{skill icon|Hammer Bolt}}.
*** {{renegade}} [[Renegade]]: {{skill icon|Citadel Bombardment}}.
** {{scrapper}} [[Scrapper]]: {{skill icon|Grenade Barrage}}.
** {{catalyst}} [[Catalyst]]: {{skill icon|Singeing Strike}}, {{skill icon|Surging Flames}}, {{skill icon|Wind Slam}}, {{skill icon|Shock Blast}}, {{skill icon|Flame Wheel}}, {{skill icon|Icy Coil}}, {{skill icon|Crescent Wind}}, {{skill icon|Rocky Loop}}, and {{skill icon|Grand Finale}}.

== Trivia ==
* Sharur was released with [[Living World Season 3]] Episode 6, [[One Path Ends]].
* In Mesopotamian mythology, [[wikipedia:Sharur (mythological weapon)|Sharur]] ("smasher of thousands") is an enchanted talking mace, the weapon and symbol of the god Ninurta.
* In Persian, ''[[wiktionary:شرور|sharur]]'' means "evil".
* The weapon's nighttime appearance is a result of residual death magic from [[Zhaitan]].
* A [[Bringer's Wrapped Hammer|"gift-wrapped" version]] of this skin can be found as part of the [[Wrapped weapons]] set.
